Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Upanishads · Müller, F. Max (Friedrich Max), 1823-1900 · 1879-84, 458 scanned pages. Published 1879–1884; F. Max Müller died 1900; the Upaniṣads are ancient; public domain in India.
